proofBoundary: The mapping is obtained by evaluating the exact SHA-classified current-client machine code at 0x00493440, including its embedded selector/jump tables. The result may be called a current-client ordering ordinal because independent current-client proof shows its return values control linked-record insertion order. It is not by itself a source-symbol proof, historical-retail equivalence proof, or authorization to select any historical-retail Technique winner.
